_comment: Third-party binaries that go into the installed application. The SHA-256 was recorded at first download and verified against python.org on 2026-11-22 (scripts/native/verify-python-pin.ps1: a fresh download matches, and python.org's detached OpenPGP signature is good and made by signingKeyFingerprint, the Windows-binaries key on https://www.python.org/downloads/metadata/pgp/). Rerun the script before every release and whenever the version changes.
